info.name: Japan SSW Backend API Testing
info.description:
Complete API test collection for the Japan SSW Platform backend. Updated to reflect all current routes including Profile sub-resources, Users, About, Alerts, and OAuth flows.

**Variables:**
- `baseUrl` — set to `http://localhost:3000/api/v1` for local dev
- `baseRootUrl` — set to `http://localhost:3000` for OAuth, About, and utility routes
- `bearerToken` — paste jobseeker JWT after login
- `employerToken` — paste employer JWT after login
- `adminToken` — paste admin JWT after login
- `companyId`, `jobId`, `applicationId`, `userId`, `educationId`, `experienceId` — paste from responses
